## What this does

Runs the agent-facing documentation refresh (`AGENTS.md` + the seven package
files) the P32.1 audit routed here and P33.7's repo-docs refresh reported but
deliberately did not fix, then closes the 200-row build-memory chain honestly.

**Agent-guidance drift fixed (file → claim):**
- `AGENTS.md` — the absolute "static, zero-JS" public-surface claim and the
  "`/curate/**` is the only exception" gotcha contradicted the landed
  architecture: zero-JS is now scoped to public *content* pages, with the named
  bounded islands `/map/`, `/network/`, `/search/` (ADR-097, per-island
  script/total ceilings per P32.15/ADR-134, no-JS fallbacks per SIG-UI-050) and
  `/curate/**` (ADR-068) called out explicitly. Key-file line counts
  re-measured; the pipeline/module tables now name the Round-10 surfaces
  (release-namespaced FTS5 search, the non-operational correction-intake
  receiver, immutable releases/records, the ADR-130 acquisition queue); the
  build-memory section gains the ADR-126/127 advisory layer (obligation-event +

  LEDGER/DEFERRALS stay the control authority, single-writer closeout stays
  shadow-mode until `D-R10-MEMORY-1`).
- `web/AGENTS.md` — Node floor `>=20` → `>=22.12.0` (P27.9); the island set and
  the four-block `lighthouserc.json` budget matrix described accurately.
- `api/AGENTS.md` — `serve-intake`/`intake-purge` + the `503
  receiver_not_operating` posture (`D-P32.16-1`), release-namespaced reads,
  re-measured counts.
- `connectors/AGENTS.md` — twenty registered connectors; `cli.py` re-measured.
- `db/AGENTS.md` — the Round-10 insert-only write surfaces (ADR-121/123/124/
  136/141) keyed; counts re-measured.
- `exports/AGENTS.md` — the release/record/search-index machinery

- `ops/AGENTS.md` — the Round-10 `sig-ops` verb families documented; new gotcha:

- `tests/AGENTS.md` — `support.py` size corrected.
- `docs/build/BUILD_INDEX.md` — the stale "46-ticket chain (Phase A, read-only)"
